cloud-dock.visualSignature: Infra dock built only from downloaded library assets: fortified machine blocks, service decks, pipe trunks, screen panels, route lights and road-bridge platforms around the harbor edge.
cloud-dock.nextCustomAsset: Do not generate placeholder GLB. Source a stronger CC0/attribution-safe server, antenna or datacenter asset from an external library before replacing this vendor-only dock.

design-atelier.visualSignature: Atelier expressed with downloaded assets only: checkerboard cutting table, worktops, crates, crane, reference screen, wood path corner and small vegetation markers as material swatches.
design-atelier.nextCustomAsset: Do not generate placeholder GLB. Source a real CC0/attribution-safe mannequin, garment rack or sewing-table asset from a library before claiming a premium atelier silhouette.

observability-tower.visualSignature: Telemetry tower built only from downloaded library assets: tall industrial structure, screen wall, hanging screen, glass pipe, machine window, route-light pylon and service platform.
observability-tower.nextCustomAsset: Do not generate placeholder GLB. Source a real CC0/attribution-safe tower, radar or telemetry-looking asset from an external library before replacing the current vendor-only tower.

corePromotion.purpose: Promote exactly one downloaded CC0 vendor anchor per hero location into the public core runtime, with no generated local GLB allowed in the visible 3D layer.
corePromotion.fallback: If any vendor anchor fails or disappears in QA, keep the rest of the downloaded vendor core and demote the failing placement until a better library asset is sourced.
corePromotion.nextAction: Replace the current generic vendor anchors only with downloaded library assets that have clear license, weight, fallback and QA proof.

publicTerrainCore.purpose: Prove the public asset-only world as a wider terrain shell before bases: downloaded car, vendor field/stony-dirt-path/relief/water-edge textures and sparse GLB shoreline, bridge, rail, relief and vegetation anchors across the outer map with no generated decorative primitives, road tiles, river tiles or hero/factory clutter.
publicTerrainCore.allowedGeneratedSubstrate: single terrain heightfield only, using shader masks over downloaded vendor textures for field/path/relief/water-edge material; visible public decor must come from downloaded vendor GLB/glTF.
publicTerrainCore.fallback: If a terrain GLB fails, omit that placement and keep the public world sparse rather than replacing it with a generated rectangle, cone, halo, plate or abstract primitive.
publicTerrainCore.nextAction: Review the denser north/south/east/west terrain-only screenshots for asset readability, then source stronger shoreline and authored relief packs before densifying Cloud Dock, Design Atelier or Observability Tower.

publicTerrainMaterialCore.purpose: Introduce a tiny offline Poly Haven CC0 glTF tranche to raise terrain material fidelity before expanding the map or densifying hero bases.
publicTerrainMaterialCore.runtimePolicy: No runtime network fetches. Poly Haven files are downloaded into public/assets/models/vendor/polyhaven with local .bin and texture references preserved.
publicTerrainMaterialCore.nextAction: Evaluate screenshot fit against the Kenney terrain vocabulary; if the scanned assets look pasted-on, color-grade/downsample or demote them before sourcing another batch.

terrainShell.purpose: Scale the playable terrain from a compact scene into a larger sparse shell with outer water, relief, road-edge and vegetation vocabulary before adding new dense hero-location detail.
terrainShell.fallback: Keep the existing 76-unit map shell and central hero locations if the larger shell fails renderer budget, boundary QA or role coverage.
terrainShell.nextAction: Use this sparse outer shell as the terrain canvas for authored road continuity, water crossings and biome transitions before adding another object-dense asset wave.

assetUtilizationWave.purpose: Move already accepted but underused GLB files out of the library and into the map inspection layer so the next quality jump comes from curated assets rather than procedural filler.
assetUtilizationWave.fallback: If this utilization wave makes the map noisy or exceeds renderer budget, keep the files accepted in the library but remove the new inspection placements before public core promotion.
assetUtilizationWave.nextAction: Use the visual QA captures to decide which utilized files deserve promotion into the public core and which should remain inspection-only.

assetDetailWave.purpose: Keep the hero-location detail wave vendor-only by using downloaded Factory Kit support pieces instead of generated local GLB details, while preserving the no-clutter inspection contract.
assetDetailWave.fallback: If these vendor detail assets read as clutter or push the renderer over budget, keep the accepted library but remove the inspection placements before public core promotion.
assetDetailWave.nextAction: Use zone screenshots to identify the exact library asset gaps before sourcing new external atelier, cloud and observability models.

terrainTransitionWave.purpose: Replace the generated terrain seam kit with downloaded Kenney Nature bridge and path pieces so road-water, road-relief and field-road transitions are proven with real library assets.
terrainTransitionWave.fallback: If the downloaded bridge/path seams cause visual noise or renderer pressure, keep the vendor files accepted but remove the inspection placements before any public core promotion.
terrainTransitionWave.nextAction: Use these vendor-only terrain screenshots to decide which external library pack should be sourced next for higher-quality roads, banks and terrain seams.

mapExpansionKits.purpose: Road, bridge and edge vocabulary for scaling the playable map with readable routes before adding more landmarks.
mapExpansionKits.fallback: Keep procedural road ribbons active until modular GLB roads prove route readability across the larger map.
mapExpansionKits.nextAction: Use this kit as the first grammar when expanding the road network outward from the current districts.

mapExpansionKits.purpose: Water, rocks, cliffs and crossing pieces for making the larger map feel authored rather than flat.
mapExpansionKits.fallback: Keep procedural water surfaces, foam and terrain heightfield visible under GLB accents if a model fails.
mapExpansionKits.nextAction: Lay out water and relief islands before increasing prop density so the map expansion has visible geography.

mapExpansionKits.purpose: Trees, bushes, grass and field texture vocabulary for open areas between hero locations.
mapExpansionKits.fallback: Keep instanced procedural field markers and vertex-colored terrain if GLB vegetation is not available.
mapExpansionKits.nextAction: Use vegetation as sparse spatial punctuation, not filler, while the larger terrain shell is being composed.

mapExpansionKits.purpose: Downloaded vendor GLB anchors and support pieces that make Cloud Dock, Design Atelier and Observability Tower recognizable without generated local models.
mapExpansionKits.fallback: Keep procedural landmark silhouettes and hero-location pads if a premium GLB anchor fails to load.
mapExpansionKits.nextAction: Promote the strongest anchor per hero location only after screenshots prove the place reads without UI text.

acceptanceRules: No integrated asset without source, license, file size, triangle budget and narrative role.
Prefer CC0 for production map assets. CC-BY is allowed only when attribution path is explicit.
Imported textures must be downsampled and color-graded before becoming production materials.
Hero locations must remain recognizable without text before the procedural fallback is removed.
Any accepted external model must have a procedural fallback until CI proves the GLB path on GitHub Pages.
